name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist from Callisto has a higher distance than Dasari.
The colonist from Titan's distance is immediately next to the colonist in the Drift module.
The colonist studying Diatoms' distance is higher than both Bauer and the colonist from Titan.
The colonist from Earth's distance is between the colonist in the Drift module and the colonist studying Diatoms.
The colonist studying Regolith's distance is lower than both Eklund and the colonist from Venus.
Eklund's distance is immediately below the colonist in the Helix module.
The colonist studying Fungus' distance is at least 2 ly more than the colonist in the Aurora module.
The colonist studying Regolith's distance is at most 2 ly away from the colonist in the Forge module.
